text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor e-x-e-c-u-t-e-d the s-p-o-t s-t-a-l-k-i-n-g t-a-s-k on the p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m and l-e-f-t a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p e-d i-t-y l-o-g e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-d-m-i-n a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-h-e-c-k.
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y p-r-o-f-i-l-e in the h-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s and l-e-f-t a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e r-o-w in the d-a-t-a-s-t-o-r-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor r-o-u-t-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a s-p-a-r-e n-o-d-e to b-y-p-a-s-s the g-a-t-e-w-a-y and l-e-f-t an o-r-p-h-a-n c-o-n-n-e-c-t-i-o-n in the p-r-o-x-y l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the n-e-t-w-o-r-k p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d t-a-l-t-e-d l-o-g l-i-n-e-s into the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e t-r-a-c-e-s and l-e-f-t a m-i-s-s-i-n-g s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r in the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor f-i-l-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r under a c-l-o-s-e-d i-c-c r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e m-a-r-k-e-r on the d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
